_about: UI speed and size budget (perf-regressions part D; autonomy/ui-perf-budget/impl.md). Checked by perf/ui_budget.mjs in CI job ui-perf, blocking. Frame limits: median of the 3 CI runners' medians on main + 15%. Byte limits: the CI build of main + 5% (gzip level 9), and the guest page's first load never over 80 KB gz (pocket-apps). A metric with no limit fails; a metric too noisy to block is listed under dropped with its numbers.

life._about: Living avatars (autonomy/living-avatars/impl.md): perf/stream/life.mjs, 30 bots (28 sidebar rows, a chat header, a 96 px Bot home) on the shared clock for 20 s with motion allowed, once per run. lifeCommits and lifeTimers: the worst run. lifeP95FrameMs: the median. p95 is PROVISIONAL: local 16.7/16.7/16.8 ms on the server (Nov 26) + 15%; set it from 3 CI runs on main after merge (median of medians + 15%).

dropped.framesOver50: too noisy to block: 9 CI runs on main 6eb1d148 gave 1,1,1 / 1,1,1 / 2,1,1 (per-run spread 100%, over the 15% rule); a +15% limit of 1.15 would fail about 1 PR run in 25 on a runner hiccup alone
